title: Scuttle Coast
wikitext:
[[image:Scuttle_Coast.jpg|thumb|The Scuttle Coast]]
The [[Scuttle Coast]] {{coords|61|52|Durotar}} is a portion of the [[Great Sea]] off the east coast of [[Kalimdor]], mostly noted by travelers on the east coast of [[Durotar]] southeast of [[Razor Hill]] near [[Tiragarde Keep]]. The coast is littered with ships from [[Kul Tiras]], smashed upon the rocks as a result of the great battles fought between the [[orcs]] and Admiral [[Daelin Proudmoore]]'s fleet. The orcs are still salvaging bits and pieces of [[gnome]] technology from the stores of the ships.

The name may be in reference to either the large ships that have been scuttled just off shore, or to the [[crab]]s and [[makrura]]s that scuttle along the shore.
